{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute raw conversion rates by channel
email_conversion_rate = completed_df[completed_df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_conversion_rate = completed_df[completed_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

difference = email_conversion_rate - paid_search_conversion_rate

# Print raw rates and difference
print(f'Raw email conversion rate: {email_conversion_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Raw paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_conversion_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Raw difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}')"}
